```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(knitr)
library(here)

here::i_am("CPCs_predict_CommunityStability/publication_experiments/data/samp_int_1/CR3/cr3_cv_viability_report.qmd")

cr3_dir <- here::here("CPCs_predict_CommunityStability", "publication_experiments", "data", "samp_int_1", "CR3")
data_path <- file.path(cr3_dir, "community_measures.RDS")

if (!file.exists(data_path)) {
  stop("community_measures.RDS is not present in this folder.")
}

extract_treatment_value <- function(values, name) {
  if (is.null(values) || is.null(values[[name]])) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  as.numeric(values[[name]])
}

r2_lm <- function(data, response) {
  data <- data |>
    filter(
      is.finite(.data[[response]]),
      is.finite(viability_cv_cp)
    )

  if (nrow(data) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(data$viability_cv_cp) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  summary(lm(stats::reformulate("viability_cv_cp", response), data = data))$r.squared
}

cr3 <- readRDS(data_path) |>
  mutate(
    uptake_width_mean = map_dbl(
      treatment_values,
      extract_treatment_value,
      name = "traits.uptake_width.mean"
    ),
    viability_cv_cp = as.numeric(cv_community_viability_binary_info),
    cv_total_abundance = as.numeric(cv_total_abundance),
    mean_total_abundance = as.numeric(mean_total_abundance)
  ) |>
  filter(
    is.finite(cv_total_abundance),
    is.finite(mean_total_abundance),
    is.finite(viability_cv_cp),
    is.finite(uptake_width_mean)
  )

overall_cv_r2 <- r2_lm(cr3, "cv_total_abundance")
uptake_width_2_3_6_9 <- cr3 |>
  filter(uptake_width_mean %in% c(2, 3, 6, 9))
uptake_width_2_3_6_9_r2 <- r2_lm(uptake_width_2_3_6_9, "cv_total_abundance")
overall_mean_r2 <- r2_lm(cr3, "mean_total_abundance")

r2_by_width <- imap_dfr(
  split(cr3, cr3$uptake_width_mean),
  function(data, width) {
    tibble(
      uptake_width_mean = as.numeric(width),
      n = nrow(data),
      r_squared = r2_lm(data, "cv_total_abundance")
    )
  }
) |>
  arrange(uptake_width_mean)

mean_r2_by_width <- imap_dfr(
  split(cr3, cr3$uptake_width_mean),
  function(data, width) {
    tibble(
      uptake_width_mean = as.numeric(width),
      n = nrow(data),
      r_squared = r2_lm(data, "mean_total_abundance")
    )
  }
) |>
  arrange(uptake_width_mean)
```

This report uses binary viability community performance variability, `cv_community_viability_binary_info`, as the consumer-resource viability $CV(CP)$ metric. Community stability is shown as `cv_total_abundance`.

## CV Total Biomass

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5

ggplot(cr3, aes(x = viability_cv_cp, y = cv_total_abundance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8, colour = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Viability CV CP",
    y = "CV total biomass",
    title = "CR3: CV total biomass versus viability CV CP",
    subtitle = paste0("Overall R-squared = ", round(overall_cv_r2, 3))
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6.5

ggplot(
  cr3,
  aes(x = viability_cv_cp, y = cv_total_abundance)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 0.9) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6, colour = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ uptake_width_mean, labeller = label_both, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Viability CV CP",
    y = "CV total biomass",
    title = "CR3: CV total biomass relationship by uptake width mean treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
r2_table <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    treatment = c("Overall", "uptake_width_mean in {2, 3, 6, 9}"),
    n = c(nrow(cr3), nrow(uptake_width_2_3_6_9)),
    r_squared = c(overall_cv_r2, uptake_width_2_3_6_9_r2)
  ),
  r2_by_width |>
    transmute(
      treatment = paste0("uptake_width_mean = ", uptake_width_mean),
      n,
      r_squared
    )
) |>
  mutate(r_squared = round(r_squared, 4))

kable(r2_table, align = c("l", "r", "r"))
```

## Mean Total Biomass

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5

ggplot(cr3, aes(x = viability_cv_cp, y = log10(mean_total_abundance), colour = as.factor(uptake_width_mean))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8, colour = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Viability CV CP",
    y = "Mean total biomass",
    title = "CR3: mean total biomass versus viability CV CP",
    subtitle = paste0("Overall R-squared = ", round(overall_mean_r2, 3))
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6.5

ggplot(
  cr3,
  aes(x = viability_cv_cp, y = log10(mean_total_abundance))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 0.9) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6, colour = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ uptake_width_mean, labeller = label_both, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = "Viability CV CP",
    y = "Mean total biomass",
    title = "CR3: mean total biomass relationship by uptake width mean treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
mean_r2_table <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    treatment = "Overall",
    n = nrow(cr3),
    r_squared = overall_mean_r2
  ),
  mean_r2_by_width |>
    transmute(
      treatment = paste0("uptake_width_mean = ", uptake_width_mean),
      n,
      r_squared
    )
) |>
  mutate(r_squared = round(r_squared, 4))

kable(mean_r2_table, align = c("l", "r", "r"))
```
